column8: Thu 19 Nov: 3e and Table 3 row 4, the reference class NUMBERS 3 (How often) can state in words: 45 ended iBonds funds, none merged, extended or more than 16 days early; closures page re-read today (IBIC, IBTA, IBCC, IBDB dates match); never ended on schedule.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e note and Table 3 note (an early end by days lands cash sooner); give each fund its own days: IBTA 15 days early by last trade (the register's figure) and 12 by cash, IBCC 16 by last trade; as written 16 and 10 reads as IBTA 16; the page dates IBCC's cash 22 Mar, not 21 Mar.

Thu 19 Nov: register practice, cite a fund's Form 497 for any end date, never the closures page alone; both read today (page shows MUAB 08/15/2012, the 12 Jun 2013 supplement sets 15 Aug 2013); research trivia, not a 3f moment under standing order 22.
Thu 19 Nov: IBDC's page slip (03/04/2020 and 04/03/2020, confirmed on the page today) is already carried by row 10's outliers and row 3's lesson; store only.

Thu 19 Nov: Table 3 row 4's Notice by 31 October, now on 13 iShares notices 48 to 66 days ahead (spot-checked: IBTB 62, IBTF 61, MUAB 64); extends Q36-004 and Q36-009 from four Treasury years to the family.

Thu 19 Nov: Table 3 row 4's window (all six Treasury notices 28 Sep to 17 Oct) and 3c's certain: each end date was voted when the fund was created (IBTB supplement read today: approved 3 Dec 2019, last trade 15 Dec, cash 21 Dec 2022).
Thu 19 Nov: Table 3 row 4's note, a missing notice is the cue to read the filings, not proof of an extension, since the scheduled end needs no notice; the 13-of-13 habit is practice, not a rule.
Thu 19 Nov: store, the sponsor's own count (24 by Dec 2021) shows the closures page lists every ended fund, so row 1 is a census, not a sample; brochure read in a third-party copy.

Thu 19 Nov: 3c or Figure 1 note, holding to a fund's end cost at most about 0.23% against its last price in any bond type (spot-checked IBCC +0.19%, IBTA -0.007%); widens Q3c-004 and Q3c-005 to all 45.
Thu 19 Nov: NUMBERS 8h and Table 3 row 4's cash, the seven-day ranges hold family-wide (43 of 45, two page slips); widens Q36-009 and Q3c-010; brokers add their own days.
Thu 19 Nov: 3e's reference class, a second sponsor's record (about 37 ended, two early by months); the count is partly from lineups and a data site, so say about and never a precise total.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e's fund events, the only months-early ends of any term ETF were two small emerging-market funds closed for business reasons; etf.com read today ($25.8m, $33.9m, 26 funds, $1.4bn, high demand product areas); verifies Q36-008's sizes.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e in words (IBTM is far larger than any term fund closed early, so the economically viable ground is remote) and a measurable sign for Table 3 row 4's note; a ratio in 3e prose would break its two-figure budget; no threshold is published.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e and Table 3 row 4, kills the reading that a moved end moves later: the one ETF family whose end moved went about two weeks earlier; the filing that moved it is still unread, so cite both dates, not the change.
Thu 19 Nov: store, closes Q36-007's excerpt (Invesco's 2018 power, earlier or later, read in full); Laura holds no Invesco fund and iShares' wording names only an extension.
Thu 19 Nov: store, supports row 33: a second sponsor's on or about also landed early, never late; release wording on emerging-market debt, not Treasuries.
Thu 19 Nov: store, notice length is a sponsor's habit (Invesco 14 days, iShares about 60); Laura holds no Invesco fund, so at most a clause in Table 3 row 4's note.
Thu 19 Nov: store, a second sponsor also pays within the seven days of Figure 1's ranges; one-line supplements, payout amounts not read.
Thu 19 Nov: store, term ETFs have paid cash at or before their dates since the first in 2011; trade press and commentary, secondary.
Thu 19 Nov: store only, the 2013 muni fund named no end day; true, serves no part.
Thu 19 Nov: store, a rename or split is not one of Table 3 row 4's events and needs no action; whether the muni rename moved an end is unchecked.
Thu 19 Nov: store, an early end came with cash at net asset value and a fee waiver; closed-end leveraged loans, far from Laura's Treasury funds.

Thu 19 Nov: store, supports row 33: later ends happened only in closed-end term funds, by shareholder vote with a tender at net asset value; ETFs need no vote to extend (Q36-002), so it is a contrast, never a protection Laura has.
Thu 19 Nov: store only, a size floor decides whether a closed-end term fund lives; Q36-006 and row 13 carry the same economics for ETFs.
Thu 19 Nov: store only; resolve Nuveen's six months (tender letter) against twelve (proxy) before any use; closed-end, not Laura's kind of fund.

Thu 19 Nov: store; State Street's two funds have not ended (set for 15 Dec 2026), so they cannot count toward no first term ETFs ran past their dates: say set to end on their stated date; the announcement is a news digest.

Thu 19 Nov: Table 3 row 4's action stands: no other fund ends in late 2032, so a swap stays an earlier iBond fund or the short-term Treasury ETF (IPS l.13 names iShares iBonds); the Invesco funds are context, never a swap target.
Thu 19 Nov: store, another sponsor's off-cycle closure gave 16 days; sector funds of other sponsors say little about iShares' habit, so at most a clause in Table 3 row 4's note.

Thu 19 Nov: Table 3 row 4's note; say iShares announced its other closures in June with August last trades (page re-read: 2020, 2021, 2024, 2026), never that an IBTM early end would come in June; the row's event triggers are not windowed and its notes already read filings in any year (bond desk 4, M5), so no cell change.
Thu 19 Nov: 3e's fund events, a merger has the power on paper (Q36-016) and no precedent among term ETFs; absence rests on bounded searches, so in words, never as a count.
Thu 19 Nov: Table 3 row 4 and NUMBERS 3, confirms the split now in the cell: the margin pays a swap's trading, the holder carries the lost interest, since no sponsor paid for it; builds on Q36-011.

Thu 19 Nov: 2.2's GOLDMINE 27 clause at most; ten target-date ETFs, not eleven (closures page and the 15 Aug 2014 Form 497 list 2010-2050 and Retirement Income); a target-date fund's date is not an end and the 2010 fund's had passed, so drop before their dates; the target-date line was read in a corporate iBonds prospectus, so check IBTM's own before tying it to her fund.

Thu 19 Nov: 3e's fund events in words, no count, no probability; but NUMBERS 3 shows an early end by months in 2031 also leaves the top short with cash at zero, so the event that hurts is any early end, merger or moved end of the late-2032 fund, not only a later end; its one precedent is two small emerging-market funds.
Thu 19 Nov: register practice only, read fund facts from the sponsor or filings, never a machine-written data page.
